items.title: GE Vernova and Blue Energy Move Forward With 2.5 GW Texas Gas-Nuclear Power Project
items.summary: Blue Energy and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy (NYSE:GEV) have agreed to advance development of a proposed 2. 5-gigawatt gas-and-nuclear power facility in Victoria, Texas, moving the project into its next phase of engineering, licensing and safety work.

items.title: Can GE Vernova's Strong Q2 Results Fuel Further Earnings Growth?
items.summary: GEV's Q2 results show accelerating growth, stronger margins and cash flow, with robust orders and a raised 2026 outlook.

items.title: 2 Cash-Producing Stocks on Our Buy List and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: Form Energy raises $750m to expand iron-air battery production
items.summary: The funds will expand manufacturing in West Virginia and support commercial rollout of Form Energy’s iron-air battery systems.

items.title: Can NuScale's TVA Opportunity Unlock Its Next Growth Phase?
items.summary: SMR's proposed TVA program could unlock licensing, engineering and equipment work tied to up to 6 GW of new nuclear capacity.

items.title: Can NuScale's Commercial Potential Justify Its Valuation?
items.summary: SMR's regulatory head start and $1.9B liquidity support commercialization, but its rich valuation raises the stakes for contract conversion.

items.title: Red-Hot Power Stocks Are Losing Steam
items.summary: For some time, it seemed as though owners of existing power plants—such as  Vistra  and  Constellation Energy  —were in a great spot.  With demand growth outstripping new power supply, incumbent power plants could reap higher prices for their output without putting much capital at risk.  Power plant owners have had a rough year on the stock market.

items.title: 3 Big Reasons to Love GE Vernova (GEV)
items.summary: GE Vernova’s 25.3% return over the past six months has outpaced the S&P 500 by 14.2%, and its stock price has climbed to $990.50 per share. This performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.
